owner_request:
Implement Flutter RegisterScreen in mobile/lib/features/auth/screens/register_screen.dart only.
- StatefulWidget with Form, GlobalKey<FormState>.
- Input fields: First Name, Last Name, Email, Password, Confirm Password.
- Password validator: at least 8 characters, confirmation matching check.
- 'Create Account' button with loading indicator during submission.
- Calls AuthApiService to register user and navigates or shows SnackBar on success/error.
- Link to navigate back to LoginScreen.
